# coderforge_param (Data Source)

Read a value from the parameter store by id or by name.

~> The value is written into Terraform state as it is read. Parameters are not the place for credentials; use `coderforge_secret` for those.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Resource id, for example `param:0012`. Specify this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Parameter name. Specify this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `is_env_capable` (Boolean)
- `is_json` (Boolean)
- `owner_rid` (String)
- `size` (Number)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `value` (String) The stored value.
